subject: Taxes
title: Nordic Tax Culture
description: A micro-lesson that makes Nordic Tax Culture usable.

hook.text: Swedes pay up to 52% in income tax and consistently rank among the happiest nations on Earth.

buildup.text: Nordic culture emphasizes collective responsibility—called 'jantelagen' in Scandinavia.

discovery.text: In return, citizens get free healthcare, free university, generous parental leave, and strong social safety nets.

twist.text: High trust comes from transparency. Sweden makes everyone's tax return public. Your neighbor can see what you paid.

climax.text: The Nordic model works because trust, transparency, and visible returns create a self-reinforcing cycle.

punchline.text: 52% tax, high happiness. The deal works when trust is total.

quiz.question: Why do Swedes accept very high tax rates?
options: High trust, transparency, and visible public services create a valued social contract
